Frequently Asked Questions

1. What is an AI SOC?

An AI SOC (Security Operations Center) uses artificial intelligence to automate threat detection, triage, and response at a scale no analyst team can match manually. The difference from a traditional SOC is coverage: an AI SOC investigates every alert, not just the ones someone has time to look at. That means faster response times, less analyst fatigue, and no alert left uninvestigated.

2. How is Radiant different from other AI SOC platforms?

Most AI SOC platforms are pre-trained on 6 to 8 alert types. Radiant is the only AI SOC built to handle every alert type across all your data sources, with no playbooks or pre-configured rules required. Integrated response actions let analysts remediate threats in a single click. Log management with unlimited data retention is included at no extra cost. Every investigation comes with a complete, explainable decision trail so your team always knows why a conclusion was reached.

3. Can Radiant replace our existing SOC tools?

No. Radiant is designed to work alongside your existing SIEM, SOAR, or MDR. Most customers start by layering Radiant on top of what they already have. Over time, some choose to consolidate parts of their stack after identifying overlaps, but that’s their call, not a requirement.

4. How does Radiant ensure transparency in AI decisions?

Trust in an AI SOC depends on being able to see its work. Every investigation Radiant runs produces a complete audit trail: what data was analyzed, how the AI SOC reached its conclusion, and why it escalated or closed the alert. Nothing is a black box. Your analysts can review any decision, stand behind every escalation, and satisfy compliance requirements without chasing down context manually.

5. What types of alerts can Radiant's AI SOC handle?

Radiant’s AI SOC triages alerts across every major attack surface: email, endpoint, identity, network, cloud, insider threat, SIEM, WAF, DLP, OT/IoT, dark web, and supply chain. It handles structured and unstructured alerts across all of them. Where other AI SOC platforms stop at a pre-defined list of supported alert types, Radiant covers 100% of them.

6. What happens when Radiant encounters something it can't fully resolve?

Every alert gets a full investigation, every time. When Radiant identifies a real threat that requires human action, it escalates with a complete analysis: what happened, which systems are affected, root cause, and recommended response steps. Your analysts get a finished investigation, not a raw alert.
